reaction.notes: Chan-Lam coupling uses Cu(II) or Cu(I) with air/O2 as oxidant. Typical conditions: Cu(OAc)2 (10-20 mol%), pyridine or TEA (2 equiv), DCM or MeOH, RT to 50 °C. Open to air or O2 balloon.

applies_if.expr: (Ar-B(OH)2 OR Vinyl-B(OH)2) AND ((Any-NH2 OR Ar-NH2 OR Bn-NH2 OR Allyl-NH2 OR Vinyl-NH2) OR (Any-NHR OR Ar-NHR OR Bn-NHR OR Allyl-NHR) OR (Indole OR Pyrrole OR Imidazole OR Pyrazole OR Triazole OR Tetrazole OR Benzimidazole OR Purine) OR (Any-CONHR OR Ar-CONHR))

default_rule.description: General starter for Chan-Lam C-N (Cu(OAc)2; pyridine; DCM; air).

reactant_features.expr: (Any-NH2 OR Ar-NH2 OR Any-NHR OR Ar-NHR)

base_rules.name: N-Heterocycles (Azoles)
base_rules.description: Chan-Lam for indoles, imidazoles, etc. Often benefits from MeOH or slightly higher temp.

reactant_features.expr: Indole OR Pyrrole OR Imidazole OR Pyrazole OR Triazole OR Tetrazole OR Benzimidazole OR Purine
